claims.statement: It has been proposed that Leonardo painted the fish and the dog (National Gallery wording: 'it has been suggested'). Wilhelm Suida (1954) is cited as the first; David Alan Brown is cited for the dog (one source) or for the dog and fish (another). The Louvre 2019 exhibition text states most art historians give the fish and dog to Leonardo.
